system.description:
Once per turn, after you damage a creature with your Primary or Secondary Weapon, or successfully target a creature with a Tech Domain card, you may apply one Intrusion.

Each creature may only have one Intrusion from you at a time. Applying another replaces the previous one.

Intrusion

Effect

Expose

The next attack against the target has Advantage.

Jam

The target has Disadvantage on its next attack.

Interference

Reduce the damage die of the target's next attack by one step.

Scramble

The target cannot gain Advantage until your next turn.

Trace

You always know the target's location until the end of the scene.
